name: Motorcycle Simulator New Hampshire
summary:
Ride Manchester, New Hampshire, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

28 KM ROUND MANCHESTER
I-93 south down the east side, I-293 west past the airport and over the Merrimack, then the Everett Turnpike up the west bank past the Fisher Cats ballpark, City Hall Plaza, the brick Amoskeag Millyard across the water and Amoskeag Falls.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
Grip the bars with your own hands. Roll your right wrist to open the throttle, brake with your left hand, push the bars to lean - the horizon tilts
